findings.title: Round-2 gate request is bound to the superseded v1 checkpoint
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 7.3 requires “an immutable final digest (sha256) of the exact submitted checkpoint and of every deliverable it relies on” and requires the gate to evaluate that digest-identified checkpoint only.
findings.trigger: The artifact under review is `P03_recovery_checkpoint.v2.md` with sha256 `2116cb003886c320e9ce5b20c7b6ad24558e23b04bce44eb0b9e96847966981d`, but the round-2 request’s immutable-checkpoint instructions identify report digest `5ae37bf...`, manifest digest `912c9d3f...`, and tree `e964ab07...`, all belonging to v1.
findings.consequence: A verdict from this request cannot be an immutable receipt for v2: the gate is explicitly instructed to evaluate a different digest-identified checkpoint and deliverable set.
findings.evidence: The request’s Artifact section names v2 and sha256 `2116cb...`, while “Where to spend your attention” says the exact submitted report is `5ae37bf...`. Direct hashing confirms v2 is `2116cb...`; the current `evidence/digest_manifest.json` hashes to `435cf1b0...`, not the request’s v1 value `912c9d3f...`.

findings.title: Published status and path ledger omit a post-freeze artifact move
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 2 requires every changed, created, moved, and deleted path to be listed; Criterion 6 requires the post-change git status and immutable coverage for every deliverable.
findings.trigger: The current worktree has staged deletion of `P03_recovery_checkpoint.v1.md` and an untracked replacement at `deprecated/P03_recovery_checkpoint.v1.md`, but the 229-line published status and ledger still list v1 as added at its original path and contain no `deprecated/` path.
findings.consequence: The report’s claimed complete 229-path delta is not the actual submitted state, and the moved v1 deliverable lacks the stated path authorization and digest accounting at its current location.
findings.evidence: Current `git status --porcelain` reports `AD plans_internal/refactor_repo/checkpoints/P03/P03_recovery_checkpoint.v1.md` and `?? plans_internal/refactor_repo/checkpoints/P03/deprecated/`; `evidence/ledger/git_status_porcelain_current.txt` instead reports `A .../P03_recovery_checkpoint.v1.md`, and neither it nor `evidence/digest_manifest.json` contains the deprecated destination.

observations: The two round-1 defects are substantively addressed: journal/evidence now show Test 2 executed before the re-executed move, and Test 7 no longer falsely equates its tested tree with the final submitted tree; the remaining differences are enumerated with a reasonable test-inertness analysis.
Section 4 repeats the fragment “reconstructed afterwards. The condition did not fire; the recorded reason is quoted”; this is editorial and does not defeat a criterion.
reasoning: I retired both prior findings after inspecting the new pre-move evidence, journal ordering, tree comparison, and failure-set evidence. The round-2 transport nevertheless identifies v1’s immutable digests rather than v2’s, and the supposedly complete ledger no longer matches the current artifact placement. These are direct failures of immutable gate binding and complete path/status accounting, so PASS is not available.
